title: Minimal Debug Menu
description: completely removes the Debug Menu and replaces it with only the information you need in a clean format and UI
body: Completely removes every feature from the debug menu and replaces it with a custom GUI in the top left instead. it will only display information that is important in a neat format. you can also use the defaulted keybind 'J' to copy your current coordinates to the clipboard. this keybind can be changed in settings under controls.
